name: twilio
label: Twilio
description: Cloud communications platform for building SMS, Voice & Messaging applications

accountSid.label: Account SID
accountSid.description: Starts with AC. Shown under Account Info in the Twilio Console.

authToken.label: Auth Token
authToken.description: Click Show under Account Info in the Twilio Console to reveal it.

phone_number_lookup.label: Phone Number Lookup
phone_number_lookup.description: Look up the carrier and line type (mobile, landline) of a number.

phone_number.label: Phone Number
phone_number.description: Phone number with country code, starting with +.

get_message.label: Get Message
get_message.description: Get the status and details of a sent or received message.

message_sid.label: Message SID
message_sid.description: Starts with SM or MM. The SMS (Twilio) step gives it as Message id, and the Twilio Console lists it under Messaging logs.

new_incoming_sms.label: New Incoming SMS
new_incoming_sms.description: Triggers when a new SMS message is received.

phone_number.label: Phone Number
phone_number.description: The Twilio number that receives the messages.

new_phone_number.label: New Phone Number
new_phone_number.description: Triggers when you add a new phone number to your account.

new_recording.label: New Recording
new_recording.description: Triggers when a new call recording is completed and available.

new_transcription.label: New Transcription
new_transcription.description: Triggers when a new call recording transcription is completed.

new_call.label: New Call
new_call.description: Triggers when a call completes (incoming or outgoing).
